classes.name: AirportCdmPartner
classes.definition: A generalization of any party participating in the Airport CDM process that originates or receives flight information and is informed by milestone procedures.

classes.name: AircraftOperator
classes.definition: The airline or operator that submits the ATC Flight Plan, provides TOBT and turn-round estimates, and manages the aircraft's turn-round.

operations.name: provideFinalTobt
operations.description: The Aircraft Operator or Ground Handler provide their most accurate TOBT taking into account the operational situation.

classes.name: GroundHandler
classes.definition: The party that performs ground handling operations and, with the Aircraft Operator, provides turn-round times such as TOBT, ACGT and ARDT.

operations.name: provideFinalTobt
operations.description: The Aircraft Operator or Ground Handler provide their most accurate TOBT taking into account the operational situation.

classes.name: AirTrafficControl
classes.definition: The air traffic control units (Area Control Centre, Approach Control, Tower) that manage flight plans, sequencing and start-up approvals.

operations.name: issueTsat
operations.description: ATC issues the Target Start Up Approval Time t-minutes before EOBT, where t is a parameter agreed locally.

classes.name: NetworkOperations
classes.definition: The network management function that issues CTOT, monitors flight progress via ETFMS, and is informed of updated estimates through DPI messages.

operations.name: issueCtot
operations.description: If the flight is regulated, a CTOT is issued by Network Operations at EOBT-2h.

classes.name: FlightCrew
classes.definition: The pilot and aircrew who request and receive start-up approval and coordinate readiness with the Ground Handler.

classes.name: StandGateManagement
classes.definition: The stakeholder responsible for stand and gate allocation decisions that depend on accurate ELDT and EOBT sharing.

classes.name: Outstation
classes.definition: The departure aerodrome of the outbound flight when different from the airport of interest, which provides ATOT to Network Operations and the Aircraft Operator.

operations.name: provideAtot
operations.description: The outstation provides ATOT to the Network Operations and Aircraft Operator.

classes.name: Flight
classes.definition: A single scheduled arriving or departing movement of an aircraft, carrying its operational status and the time quantities that describe its progress.

attributes.name: operationalStatus
attributes.description: The current operational status of the flight, updated at each milestone (e.g. INITIATED, AIRBORNE, LANDED, OFF-BLOCK).

attributes.name: isRegulated
attributes.description: Whether the flight is regulated and has received a CTOT from Network Operations at EOBT-2 hours; appropriate fields are marked as REGULATED.

operations.name: updateOperationalStatus
operations.description: The flight's operational status changes to the status recorded at each milestone (e.g. INITIATED, AIRBORNE, FIR, FINAL, LANDED, IN-BLOCK, SEQUENCED, BOARDING, READY, OFF-BLOCK, DEPARTED/TAKE OFF).

classes.name: TurnRound
classes.definition: The linked pair of an arriving and a departing flight of the same aircraft at an airport, over which the turn-round period is defined and analysed.

attributes.name: minimumTurnRoundTime
attributes.description: The defined minimum turn-round period (MTTT) used as a calculation basis for TOBT and TTOT.

attributes.name: estimatedTurnRoundTime
attributes.description: The estimated turn-round period (ETTT) used to calculate TOBT after ground handling starts.

classes.name: Aircraft
classes.definition: The physical aircraft performing a flight, identified by type and registration, which may be updated from the ATC Flight Plan.

attributes.name: aircraftType
attributes.description: The type of aircraft performing the flight, which may be updated from the ATC Flight Plan.

attributes.name: registration
attributes.description: The aircraft registration provided as part of consistent flight data before the first E-DPI message.

classes.name: AtcFlightPlan
classes.definition: The ICAO flight plan, including repetitive flight plans, submitted by the Aircraft Operator and distributed by the IFPS to ATC units.

attributes.name: isRepetitive
attributes.description: Whether the flight plan is a repetitive flight plan (RFPL) covering daily or weekly flights.

attributes.name: firstDestination
attributes.description: The first destination aerodrome data that must be consistent before the first E-DPI message is sent.

classes.name: AirportSlot
classes.definition: The airport slot allocated under the airport slot programme against which the ATC Flight Plan and flight data are checked for consistency.

attributes.name: allocatedTime
attributes.description: The time allocated to the flight under the airport slot programme, which the ATC Flight Plan must be consistent with.

attributes.name: coordinationStatus
attributes.description: Whether the airport is coordinated or non coordinated, which determines whether the outbound flight is already known or must be initiated from the flight plan.

classes.name: AirportFlightData
classes.definition: The locally held airport data describing a flight that must be consistent with the ATC Flight Plan and Airport Slot before the first E-DPI is sent.

classes.name: TimeQuantity
classes.definition: An abstract time value describing a flight's progress, recorded with its prefix, originator and time of update, with every successive value kept rather than overwritten.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The time value of this quantity for the flight.

attributes.name: prefix
attributes.description: Identifies whether the value is scheduled, estimated, target, actual, or calculated.

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: The stakeholder or system that provided or calculated this value.

attributes.name: recordedAt
attributes.description: The time this value was recorded; every successive value is appended rather than overwriting the prior one, so the turn-round can be analysed afterwards.

operations.name: recordUpdate
operations.description: Every successive value is kept, with its originator and time of update, so a turn-round can be analysed afterwards; an update appends rather than overwriting.

classes.name: OffBlockTime
classes.definition: The scheduled, target or actual value of the off-block event (EOBT, TOBT, AOBT) for a flight.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The accuracy of the actual off-block time (AOBT), +/- 1 minute.

classes.name: InBlockTime
classes.definition: The estimated or actual value of the in-block event (EIBT, AIBT) for an arriving flight.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The accuracy of the actual in-block time (AIBT), +/- 1 minute.

classes.name: LandingTime
classes.definition: The estimated or actual value of the landing event (ELDT, ALDT) for an arriving flight.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The accuracy of the actual landing time (ALDT), +/- 1 minute.

classes.name: TakeOffTime
classes.definition: The estimated, target, calculated or actual value of the take-off event (ETOT, TTOT, CTOT, ATOT) for a departing flight.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The accuracy of the actual take-off time (ATOT), +/- 1 minute.

attributes.name: tolerance
attributes.description: The TTOT tolerance (e.g. 5 minutes after take off from outstation) respected before Network Operations is informed of an updated TTOT.

classes.name: StartUpApprovalTime
classes.definition: The target or actual value of the start-up approval event (TSAT, ASAT) for a departing flight.

attributes.name: toleranceWindow
attributes.description: The locally agreed TSAT tolerance window within which start-up must be requested and approved before partners are alerted.

classes.name: StartBoardingTime
classes.definition: The actual time at which boarding of a flight starts (ASBT).

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The accuracy of the actual start boarding time (ASBT), +/- 1 minute.

classes.name: ReadyTime
classes.definition: The actual time at which an aircraft is ready for start-up and push-back (ARDT).

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The accuracy of the actual ready time (ARDT), +/- 1 minute.

attributes.name: tolerance
attributes.description: The tolerance after TOBT at which the AO/GH is informed that no ready status has yet been received.

classes.name: StartUpRequestTime
classes.definition: The actual time at which start-up is requested by the flight crew (ASRT).

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The accuracy of the actual start-up request time (ASRT), +/- 1 minute.

classes.name: DurationEstimate
classes.definition: A duration used to calculate other time quantities, such as estimated taxi-out time (EXOT), estimated taxi-in time (EXIT), minimum turn-round time (MTTT), estimated turn-round time (ETTT), or the flight plan's estimated elapsed time.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value of the estimated duration.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Identifies which duration estimate this is: estimated taxi-out time (EXOT), estimated taxi-in time (EXIT), minimum turn-round time (MTTT), estimated turn-round time (ETTT), or estimated elapsed time.

classes.name: Milestone
classes.definition: An abstract representation of one of the sixteen defined events in the CDM process, each with its own trigger, timing rule, effect and procedure.

attributes.name: milestoneNumber
attributes.description: The sequential number, from 1 to 16, identifying this milestone in the CDM process.

attributes.name: resultingStatus
attributes.description: The operational status the flight changes to when this milestone occurs.

classes.name: AtcFlightPlanActivation
classes.definition: The milestone at which the ATC Flight Plan is submitted and the Airport CDM Platform is initiated for the flight.

operations.name: checkConsistency
operations.description: This check shall be performed to verify the consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot and Airport flight data before the first E-DPI is sent.

operations.name: validateDataBeforeFirstEdpi
operations.description: The AO must provide correct information before this first E-DPI message, in order to feed Network Operations with consistent SOBT, aircraft registration, and first destination data, as early in time as possible. The E-DPI message should not be sent if no or inconsistent information is provided.

operations.name: initiateOutboundFlight
operations.description: For non coordinated airports, the flight plan is used to initiate the outbound flight.

operations.name: checkFlightReadiness
operations.description: The flight is ready not later than 15 minutes after the planned EOBT.

classes.name: EobtMinusTwoHourCheck
classes.definition: The milestone at EOBT-2 hours at which regulated flights receive a CTOT and Network Operations is informed by the first T-DPI message.

operations.name: checkFeasibility
operations.description: This check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan estimated off block time at EOBT-2 hrs, by checking whether AO/GH flight estimates are consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsViaFirstTdpi
operations.description: At EOBT-2 hrs Network Operations is informed through the first T-DPI message about the updated take off time estimate.

operations.name: calculateTtot
operations.description: Calculation basis for the TTOT shall take into account EIBT+MTTT+EXOT, if later than EOBT+EXOT. In the case of manual input of TOBT, this estimate will override the EIBT+MTTT estimate, hence TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT.

operations.name: updateEldtFromFum
operations.description: For inbound flights, ELDT is updated based on information provided by the FUM messages, taking into account the actual progress of the flight.

operations.name: markFieldsAsRegulated
operations.description: Mark appropriate fields as REGULATED.

classes.name: TakeOffFromOutstation
classes.definition: The milestone at which ATOT from the outstation is received and used to update ELDT and, when needed, inform Network Operations via a T-DPI-t message.

operations.name: calculateEldtFromAtot
operations.description: If the departure airport is more than 3hrs flying time from the destination airport, using the ATOT an ELDT can be calculated by using the Estimated Elapsed Time on the FPL.

operations.name: checkFeasibility
operations.description: This check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan at take off from outstation, by checking whether the AO/GH estimated landing time is consistent with the outbound ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: calculateTtot
operations.description: Calculation basis for the TTOT shall take into account EIBT+MTTT+EXOT. In case EOBT is later than EIBT+MTTT, TTOT equals EOBT+EXOT. In the case where TOBT is available this prediction will overrule the EIBT+MTTT estimate, hence TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT.

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfToleranceExceeded
operations.description: A TTOT tolerance of 5 minutes is respected before Network Operations is informed of the updated TTOT using a T-DPI-t Message.

classes.name: LocalRadarUpdate
classes.definition: The milestone at which the flight is detected entering the FIR or local airspace, triggering a TOBT process and ELDT/EIBT update.

operations.name: triggerTobtUpdate
operations.description: Update of the ELDT can trigger a new TOBT to be entered by the AO/GH, or calculated automatically by the Airport CDM Platform.

operations.name: checkStandGateChangePreference
operations.description: Taking into account the taxi-in time (EXIT), any change to a stand or gate is not preferred after ELDT-30'.

operations.name: calculateEibt
operations.description: An estimated in-block time (EIBT) is computed using the ELDT and the estimated taxi-in time.

operations.name: checkFeasibility
operations.description: This process commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan; this check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the up-dated TOBT.

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfToleranceExceeded
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: FinalApproach
classes.definition: The milestone at which the flight enters final approach at the destination, triggering a new TOBT determination.

operations.name: triggerTobtUpdate
operations.description: Update of the ELDT to determine a new TOBT.

operations.name: checkFeasibility
operations.description: This process commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan; this check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the up-dated TOBT.

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfToleranceExceeded
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: Landed
classes.definition: The milestone at which ALDT is recorded, triggering updates to TOBT, TTOT and EIBT.

operations.name: updateTobtAndTtot
operations.description: The occurrence of ALDT triggers an update of downstream estimates: TOBT and TTOT are updated automatically or inserted manually by the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler, calculated on the basis of the defined turn-round period for the departing flight.

operations.name: calculateEibt
operations.description: The EIBT can be updated according to the ALDT+EXIT.

operations.name: checkFeasibility
operations.description: This check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan, by checking whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfToleranceExceeded
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: InBlock
classes.definition: The milestone at which AIBT is recorded, triggering updates to TOBT and TTOT based on the estimated turn-round period.

operations.name: updateTobtAndTtot
operations.description: The occurrence of AIBT should trigger an update of downstream estimates: TOBT and TTOT are updated automatically or inserted manually by the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler, calculated on the basis of the estimated turn-round period for the departing flight.

operations.name: checkFeasibility
operations.description: This check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan, by checking whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfToleranceExceeded
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: GroundHandlingStarted
classes.definition: The milestone at which ground handling commences (ACGT) for first-of-day or long-parked flights, triggering a TOBT update.

operations.name: updateTobt
operations.description: The occurrence of ACGT triggers an update of downstream estimates: TOBT is updated automatically or inserted manually by the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler, calculated on the basis of the estimated turn-round period for the departing flight.

operations.name: checkFeasibility
operations.description: This check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan, by checking whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfToleranceExceeded
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: FinalConfirmationOfTobt
classes.definition: The milestone at which the Aircraft Operator or Ground Handler provides their most accurate TOBT ahead of TSAT issue.

operations.name: checkFeasibility
operations.description: This check should be performed at a predefined time (local parameter) to confirm TOBT prior to TSAT issue and verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan estimates given the updated TOBT, by checking whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfToleranceExceeded
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

operations.name: introduceIntoPredepartureSequence
operations.description: The flight is introduced into the pre-departure sequence.

operations.name: requiresConfirmation
operations.description: No need to confirm an existing TOBT if it has been manually modified before.

classes.name: TsatIssued
classes.definition: The milestone at which ATC issues the Target Start-Up Approval Time and checks the number of subsequent TOBT updates.

operations.name: notifyPartnersOfTsat
operations.description: To inform all relevant partners of the TSAT that has been allocated to the flight.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsViaTdpiS
operations.description: The Network Operations is informed by a T-DPI-s for non regulated flights.

operations.name: checkTobtUpdateCountExceedsTolerance
operations.description: A check shall be performed to see the number of TOBT updates after TSAT has been issued. In case the number of TOBT updates exceeds a threshold, then the TOBT input should be processed according to local procedure.

classes.name: BoardingStarts
classes.definition: The milestone at which boarding of passengers physically starts, used to check whether TOBT will be respected.

operations.name: notifyActualStartBoardingTime
operations.description: To inform all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Start Boarding Time (ASBT) when it occurs.

operations.name: checkBoardingStatus
operations.description: At a certain time before TOBT (local variable e.g. corresponding to aircraft type) a check shall be performed to check the boarding status, whether boarding starts in time to respect TOBT, and inform the AO/GH in case TOBT needs to be updated.

classes.name: AircraftReady
classes.definition: The milestone at which the aircraft is ready for start-up and push-back, informing partners and checking against TOBT.

operations.name: notifyActualReadyTime
operations.description: To inform all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Ready Time (ARDT) in the Airport CDM Platform and that the aircraft is ready for start up / push-back.

operations.name: checkReadyStatusReceived
operations.description: At TOBT + tolerance the AO/GH are informed that TOBT has passed and the Airport CDM Platform has not yet received ARDT or Ready Status (RDY).

classes.name: StartUpRequested
classes.definition: The milestone at which start-up is requested by the pilot, with an alert if no request is made within the TSAT tolerance window.

operations.name: notifyActualStartUpRequestTime
operations.description: To inform all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Start up Request Time (ASRT) in the Airport CDM Platform.

operations.name: checkStartUpRequestedWithinTolerance
operations.description: To alert all relevant Airport CDM Partners when no start up has been requested inside the locally agreed TSAT tolerance window. If the start up request is not made by TSAT + tolerance, the AO/GH is informed that no start up has been requested, and should update TOBT.

classes.name: StartUpApproved
classes.definition: The milestone at which ATC grants start-up approval, checked against TSAT with resequencing if not granted in time.

operations.name: notifyActualStartUpApprovalTime
operations.description: To inform all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual start up approval Time (ASAT) in the Airport CDM Platform and that the aircraft has received start up approval / push-back clearance.

operations.name: checkAsatAgainstTsat
operations.description: A check shall be performed to check if ASAT is in accordance to TSAT and to alert all relevant Airport CDM Partners when no start up has been granted. In case the start up approval is not granted at TSAT + tolerance, all relevant partners should be informed.

operations.name: resequenceFlight
operations.description: The flight will be re-sequenced.

classes.name: OffBlock
classes.definition: The milestone at which the aircraft pushes back, recorded as AOBT and always triggering an A-DPI message to Network Operations.

operations.name: notifyActualOffBlockTime
operations.description: To inform all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Off-Block Time (AOBT) in the Airport CDM Platform and that the aircraft has commenced push-back / taxi from parking position.

operations.name: updateTtot
operations.description: TTOT updated considering the EXOT.

operations.name: checkTtotToleranceExceeded
operations.description: To check if TTOT changes by more than the agreed tolerance and inform Network Operations.

operations.name: sendADpi
operations.description: AOBT always triggers an A-DPI message to Network Operations or in the case of remote holding at a defined time prior to TTOT. After a first A-DPI is sent this check shall be performed to check TTOT updates against the TTOT tolerance before Network Operations is informed, with a new A-DPI, of the updated TTOT.

classes.name: TakeOff
classes.definition: The milestone at which the aircraft takes off, recorded as ATOT, generating an airborne message and removing the flight from the departure sequence.

operations.name: notifyActualTakeOff
operations.description: To inform all relevant Airport CDM Partners about the actual take off.

operations.name: generateAirborneMessage
operations.description: An airborne message is generated and the flight is removed from the departure sequence.

operations.name: sendFsaAndMvtMessages
operations.description: FSA and MVT messages are sent.

classes.name: AirportCdmPlatform
classes.definition: The central CDM system that is initiated for each flight, processes available information, and performs the Action on CDM Operation updates and partner notifications described at each milestone.

operations.name: commenceDpiProcess
operations.description: The DPI process commences the correct messaging with Network Operations (if implemented).

classes.name: AtcSystem
classes.definition: The ATC system, including Tower FDPS, that provides landing, in-block and off-block times and calculates EXOT.

operations.name: calculateExot
operations.description: Following the receipt of the TOBT, the ATC system will calculate and provide the Estimated Taxi-Out Time (EXOT) based on the predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use, and waiting period at the Holding Position, etc.

classes.name: SurveillanceRadarSystem
classes.definition: The radar system (including A-SMGCS) that detects a flight by its assigned SSR code when it crosses the FIR/ATC boundary or enters final approach.

operations.name: detectFlightAtFirBoundary
operations.description: The radar system is able to detect a flight based upon the assigned SSR code when the flight crosses a defined FIR/ATC boundary.

operations.name: detectFlightOnFinalApproach
operations.description: The radar system detects a flight based upon the assigned SSR code and identifies when the flight crosses either a defined range/position or passes/leaves a predetermined level.

classes.name: Acars
classes.definition: The aircraft communications addressing and reporting system that provides landing, in-block, off-block and take-off times for equipped aircraft.

classes.name: AutomatedDockingSystem
classes.definition: An automated system that detects an aircraft's arrival in-block or departure off-block.

classes.name: Etfms
classes.definition: The Network Operations system that monitors a flight's progress and generates Flight Update Messages when the flight is within three hours of the destination.

operations.name: monitorFlightProgress
operations.description: If the flight is within 3hrs flying time of the destination airport the Network Operations monitors progress of the flight using the ETFMS.

operations.name: sendFum
operations.description: Network Operations sends a Flight Update Message (FUM) that provides updates of the flight's progress.

classes.name: Ifps
classes.definition: The system that distributes the submitted ATC Flight Plan to all involved ATC units.

classes.name: FlightInformationDisplaySystem
classes.definition: The airport system, including flight information display and public address systems, used to inform partners and pre-call passengers.

classes.name: DpiMessage
classes.definition: A Departure Planning Information message exchanged with Network Operations at defined milestones, distinguished by its type (E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, A-DPI).

attributes.name: messageType
attributes.description: The type of DPI message exchanged with Network Operations (E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, or A-DPI).

attributes.name: sobt
attributes.description: The scheduled off-block time carried in the first E-DPI message, required to be consistent before it is sent.

attributes.name: aircraftRegistration
attributes.description: The aircraft registration carried in the first E-DPI message.

attributes.name: firstDestination
attributes.description: The first destination data carried in the first E-DPI message.

classes.name: FlightUpdateMessage
classes.definition: The FUM message sent by Network Operations that provides updates of an inbound flight's progress.

classes.name: ReadyStatusMessage
classes.definition: The Ready Status (RDY) message confirming that a flight follows the indicated TOBT and is ready for start-up.

classes.name: StartUpRequestMessage
classes.definition: The message by which the flight crew requests start-up, made by voice or DCL.

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: The method by which the start-up request is made, by voice or by DCL.

classes.name: MovementMessage
classes.definition: A message sent on actual take-off informing partners of the flight's movement, including FSA, MVT and the airborne message.

attributes.name: messageType
attributes.description: The type of movement message sent on actual take off (FSA, MVT, or airborne message).

packages.name: Stakeholders
packages.description: The parties that take part in the process and originate or receive its information.

packages.name: Flights
packages.description: The flight, turn-round, aircraft, and the flight plan and slot that describe them, including the flight's operational status.

packages.name: Timings
packages.description: The time quantities that describe a flight's progress, each with its origin, accuracy, and tolerance.

packages.name: Milestones
packages.description: The sixteen events, each with its trigger, timing rule, effect, and procedure.

packages.name: Systems
packages.description: The technical systems that hold, compute, and display the process information, including the CDM platform and its actions.

packages.name: Messages
packages.description: The messages exchanged between stakeholders and systems.
